_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every price SciTeX publishes. Operator decision 2026-08-01: 「SSOT にしましょう」 / 「価格はjson あたりにしておくと使いやすいかと」. Before this file, /services/ hard-coded 9 JPY rows in its template and /landing/ hard-coded 12 USD items in its view; the two disagreed by up to 2.7x on the same service. Change a number HERE and it reaches every page and the brochure PDF together. A literal price anywhere else is a bug — tests/scitex_hub/public_app/test_pricing_ssot.py enforces it.
_amount_is_the_only_truth: Store the NUMBER, never a formatted string. Rendering derives '無料' from amount 0, the '〜' suffix from from_price, the '月額' prefix from unit, and — for a row with `policy` — the selling price from `amount` (always the LIST price, as upstream's list_amount) and the active window in pricing_policies. Never write the discounted number here: 1,490 is 2,980 × 50%, and storing both is two representations of one fact, which is the duplication this file exists to remove.
tax_note: 表示価格はすべて税込(総額)です。
_published_prices_are_the_tokushoho_list: The price list the 特定商取引法 page publishes, and the ONLY list it publishes. Operator decision 2026-09-03, relayed by business. UPSTREAM: github.com/ywatanabe1989/scitex-business, scitex-kk/config/business.yaml (the BUSINESS repo — not scitex-ai/scitex-business, which is the engine package; same name, two orgs). Every row here was checked against that file on 2026-09-02: id, label, amount, interval, available_from. All amounts tax-INCLUDED, operator ruling 2026-09-03: 「税込みとしてだしましょう」. THE PUBLICATION RULE IS business.yaml's, verbatim, so an export can replace this hand-copy without changing what the page shows: a row is published iff `available_from` (YYYY-MM) is SET and <= the current month. No available_from = not for sale at a list price (business.yaml's 18 usage-billed rows — API, storage, compute, traffic — have none and are permanently excluded). A future month = in the catalogue, off the page, appears on its month with no code change — so a deploy is still the human gate on what a legal page says; the derivation is automatic, the publication is a diff someone reads. `status` is NOT a gate: all 26 upstream rows are `draft`, including the six on the page by decision. Labels follow the SSoT exactly (コンサル, not コンサルティング) because a hand-maintained exception on the page would be overwritten by the first mechanical export.

_subscription_status.note:
PRICES ARE PUBLISHED; BILLING IS NOT OPEN. Operator decision 2026-08-28, prices revised 2026-09-03. Three places must agree and this key is the contract between them:
  (1) published_prices above — the current catalogue, tax-included; the available_from gate keeps unreleased services off the page
  (2) BILLING_PLANS (settings_commerce.py) stays [] — so /pricing/ lists no checkout button and billing_checkout refuses; the payment path is shut at TWO points (operator-only, and it aborts without a Stripe key)
  (3) /特商法/ states the prices AND that card payment begins after Stripe's corporate review — so the page never simultaneously denies and advertises paid plans
The previous state was not_offered, whose contract was the mirror image: 'no paid plans exist, keep all three saying so'. Do not move ONE of the three without the other two; that inconsistency is exactly what this key exists to prevent.
_subscription_status.lab_tier_retired_2026_09_03: SciTeX Lab 月額 100,000円 was published 2026-08-28 and RETIRED 2026-09-03 (business commit 0fb4ab9: ラボ・機関プランを廃し、オンプレ導入／保守サポートに置き換える). It stayed on the public 特商法 page for six days after retirement because this file was not updated with business.yaml. Found by the operator while filling in the Stripe activation form — the reviewer reads this page, and a price for something not for sale is grounds for a query.
_subscription_status.early_adopter_price_published_2026_09_02: The two subscription rows were WITHHELD from 19:38Z to 20:09Z on 2026-09-02 because 2,980 / 5,980 are list prices nobody pays under the active Launch/Y1 50% window. business ruled (operator: 「今日決めた SOHO の資料通りで良い」) to publish the discounted price with the window's end and the price after it, plus what the subscription includes (storage, compute credit, traffic, metered overage, user-set monthly cap) — 特商法 lists サービスの内容 as well as 価格.
_subscription_status.academic_rename_2026_09_03: サブスク・学生 → サブスク・学術 (business.yaml PR #54, operator Telegram 6924/6929): a university address proves AFFILIATION, not student status — faculty share the domain — so the name now matches what is verified. eligibility became 大学・研究機関のメールアドレスを持つこと（学生・院生・教職員・研究員）. The id subscription-student is deliberately unchanged: the five-year plan and this file reference it. Price unchanged (business re-summed all five years).

_withheld_is_a_gate: A row with a non-empty `withheld` is in the catalogue and NOT published, whatever its available_from says. It is a stated reason, not a flag — an empty string is not a hold. Use it for a price whose AMOUNT is settled but whose PRESENTATION is not; delete the field to publish. Used 2026-09-02 19:38Z–20:09Z on the two subscription rows while business settled how a list price under an active discount may be shown; no row is withheld now, and a test pins that.
_published_prices_fields: category (subscription | service), description, attributes and price_is_floor are copied VERBATIM from business.yaml so /services/ can describe each offer without hub inventing a sentence. Two deliberate omissions when copying: internal planning notes (e.g. 「計画上はこの下限を使う」) are not customer copy and stay upstream; and a price restated inside a description is dropped, because `amount` is the only truth in this file. price_is_floor is the upstream fact; from_price is how this file renders it (円〜).
_consulting_bands_retired_2026_09_02: Until 2026-09-02 this file carried a `consulting` list (技術相談 11,000 / コードレビュー 33,000〜 / 環境構築 55,000〜 / 個別開発 110,000〜 / 継続支援 月額 33,000〜 / 技術顧問 月額 55,000〜) and a three-tier `plans` list (Individual / Lab / Enterprise) that cited them. business retired both: the operator-approved five-year plan — the SOHO tenancy application and the bank's supporting document — is built on 受託開発 198,000円/件 × 8 and コンサル 9,800円/時間 × 48h/yr, so a site saying 110,000円〜 for the same work put three different prices on one product. The CAPABILITY is not retired: 技術相談・コードレビュー・環境構築 are what コンサル 9,800円/時間 covers. What retired was the packaging from one 2024 invoice to one customer — a history, not a maintained price list. If package pricing ever returns it enters business.yaml first, then the plan, then this file; never this file first. The Lab tier had already been retired on 2026-08-28 and was still priced on /services/ until this change.
_tiers: The /services/ tiers, in business's words (2026-09-02). The axis is 'use it yourself' (サブスク) vs 'install it in an organisation' (オンプレ) vs 'department / university scale' (大規模, quote only). `rows` cite published_prices ids; the page renders each cited row's label and price, so the tier copy never carries a number. Every tier links to the same inquiry form — for 大規模 the form is the only entry.

_pricing_policies: Discount schedules, copied VERBATIM from business.yaml pricing_policies. A row that carries `policy` sells at its `amount` (the LIST price) minus the percent of the window whose DATES cover the day the page renders — selection is by date, exactly as the business engine's Price.from_mapping does it; `status` only marks which single phase is current (two may not be active at once) and is NOT read here (business, 2026-09-03 06:54Z, correcting their 00:02Z hold; the 50→30→10 taper is a settled decision, operator Telegram 6913). The page states, before the period: the list price and the discount (「定価 2,980円、早期導入割引 50%」 — operator Telegram 6915 wants 割引 named, because reducing a discount reads more honestly than raising a price later), then when the window ends, then every later stage at its own percent and finally the list price from the day after the last window. Disclosing all stages up front is what keeps 「定価」 a stated future price and not a 景表法 claim of past sales; a struck-through pair is still refused.
